fixed.member: og.TerrainScatter on a terrain with a height blend
fixed.summary: Moves frames: a copy now grows by its layer's weight as the height blend draws it (at even heights, a layer shows only within its window under the strongest), not by the raw weight before the blend. Trees no longer stand on rock whose control channel still holds a little grass at a biome's edge; where the blend draws the layer whole every copy grows. A terrain without a height blend places as before.
